name: Indutrade AB (publ)
summary: Indutrade AB (publ) markets and sells components, systems, and services to various industries worldwide. The company operates through eight business areas: Benelux, DACH, Finland, Flow Technology, Fluids & Mechanical Solutions, Industrial Components, Measurement & Sensor Technology, and UK. It is involved in the sale of components, as well as the customization, combination, and installation of products from various suppliers. The company also provides components and systems for controlling, measuring, monitoring, and regulating flows, as well as for industrial production and maintenance; hydraulic and mechanical components; and medical technology equipment. In addition, it offers measurement instruments, measurement systems, sensors, control and regulating technology, and monitoring equipment; and custom-manufactured niche products, design solutions, aftermarket and assembly services, and customization services. Further, the company provides valves, hydraulic and industrial equipment, measurement and process technology, automation products, construction materials, service, filters, pipes and pipe systems, auto repair, tools and transmission, industrial springs, water and wastewater, lighting, chemical technology, fasteners, electronics, vehicles, energy, springs, piston rings, press work, and valve channels. Indutrade AB (publ) was founded in 1978 and is based in Kista, Sweden.
